requirements.evidence: Covers both tables with the named indexes and the stored generated owner_seq column (create_entity_memberships_table.php:26-29, 'storedAs("CASE WHEN role = 'owner' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END")'). Contract models/enum/factories/policies are all present. Middleware handles 0/1/>1 and returns 403 for non-members (EnsureCurrentEntity.php:28-55). HomeController handles 0/1/>1. pick returns 403 before touching the session and logs to the audit channel (EntityController.php:30-37). CreateEntity retries on UniqueConstraintViolationException and calls the overridable uniqueSlug() on every attempt (CreateEntity.php:51-69). Switcher uses the required button classes and data-current; the navbar link appears only for >1 membership; lang keys exist in both locales; database-schema.md is updated. Small gaps: a slug of 'switcher' (an entity named "Switcher") would be shadowed by the /e/switcher route, and a soft-deleted session entity makes the middleware return 403 instead of re-dispatching.

conventions.evidence: Follows: #[Validate] + $this->validate() (CreateEntity.php:20,28), #[Fillable] on models, reversible migrations, Bulma markup, reuse of x-form-field/x-button, CHANGELOG/docs updated. Deviations: the domain write (entity + owner membership) lives in the Livewire component instead of an app/Actions/CreateEntity class; authorization uses hand-rolled abort_unless(membershipFor(...)) in EntityController.php:30 and Dashboard.php:19 rather than the new EntityPolicy via $this->authorize/Gate; the custom current_entity middleware is not registered with Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware (policy rule 6).

security.evidence: Membership is checked server-side in pick, the middleware and Dashboard::mount; Dashboard's entity is #[Locked] (Dashboard.php:14). The owner role is hard-coded server-side (CreateEntity.php:60). All output uses {{ }}; mass assignment is restricted with #[Fillable]. Gaps: CreateEntity::submit() never calls $this->authorize('create', Entity::class), which the Livewire policy requires (impact is limited because create always returns true); there is no rate limit on entity creation; current_entity is not a persistent Livewire middleware (no actions exist yet, so currently harmless).

tests.evidence: Four test files cover: model, scopes and the DB rejection of a second owner (EntityModelTest.php); every policy branch (EntityPolicyTest.php); onboarding happy path, validation, slug sequence, retry on insert-time collision via an overridden uniqueSlug, creator-is-owner, and the audit log (EntityOnboardingTest.php); home dispatch, middleware branches, 403 on a foreign entity, pick with the session left untouched, switcher markup, navbar link, guest redirects (EntityTenantTest.php). Missing: an unauthorized-call or tamper test for CreateEntity::submit, and an assertion that the audit log goes to the 'audit' channel specifically (MessageLogged does not tell channels apart).

simplicity.evidence: Mostly lean. Duplication: the 0/1/>1 dispatch is repeated in HomeController.php:15-31 and EnsureCurrentEntity.php:27-45; roleFor/isManager are copied between the two policies; CurrentEntity exposes both get() and entity() with identical bodies (CurrentEntity.php:22-30); the abort_unless($user !== null) check in the middleware is redundant after 'auth'.

readability.evidence: Clear names, small methods and PHPDoc that matches sibling files. Minor noise: the unreachable LogicException with a 'static analysis' comment (CreateEntity.php:72-73) and the duplicate CurrentEntity accessors.

scope.evidence: Adds two unrelated CI/CD workflows, .github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml (a deploy pipeline that uses the HOSTINGER_API secret and has a skip_tests input) and .github/workflows/tests.yml. The task did not ask for either. The rest of the diff serves the task, and the out-of-scope members/settings pages were not built.

issues.explanation: Adds a deploy-to-VPS pipeline (with secrets and a skip-tests switch) and a CI workflow, neither of which the task requested.
The domain write that creates the entity and its owner membership is done inside the Livewire component, not in an app/Actions/CreateEntity class as the project requires.
submit() is a public Livewire action but never calls $this->authorize('create', Entity::class), which breaks the Livewire policy's 'authorize every action' rule.
Authorization is a hand-rolled membershipFor check instead of going through the new EntityPolicy::view via authorize/Gate.
The custom current_entity middleware is not registered with Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware, so it would stop applying to Livewire update requests (policy rule 6).
uniqueSlug() does not reserve route words: an entity named 'Switcher' gets slug 'switcher', and its dashboard URL /e/switcher resolves to the switcher route instead.
There is no unauthorized-call or tamper test for the CreateEntity::submit action, and the audit-log assertions never check that the 'audit' channel was used.
get() and entity() are duplicate accessors, and the 0/1/>1 membership dispatch is repeated in both HomeController and the middleware.
An unreachable LogicException exists only to satisfy static analysis, and the project does not run static analysis.

review.summary: The change implements the entity data model with a portable DB-enforced single-owner index, the policies, the tenant middleware, onboarding with slug-collision retry, the switcher, the dashboard and the navbar link, with broad and meaningful tests. Approval is blocked by unrelated CI/deploy workflows added outside the task scope and by the domain write not going through an Action. Smaller convention and security gaps also need fixing before merge: no $this->authorize in submit(), hand-rolled checks instead of the policies, and a non-persistent Livewire middleware.
